preconditions.expression: all(line.strip() == line for line in stdin.splitlines())
preconditions.description: Each line in stdin has no leading or trailing whitespace.
The first line of stdin is an integer N where 1 ≤ N ≤ 1000.
The number of lines in stdin equals N + 1 (1 for N, N for commands).
Each command line has at most 100 characters.
Each command line ends with a period.

preconditions.expression: all(' ' not in line.split()[-1] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: No command line has trailing space before the period.

postconditions.expression: all(line.startswith('Simon says ') and line[12:] in stdout.splitlines() or not line.startswith('Simon says ') for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: For each command line, if it begins with 'Simon says ', the rest of the line (after 'Simon says ') is included in stdout; otherwise, it is excluded.
Each line in stdout starts with a space (the part after 'Simon says ').
Each line in stdout ends with a period.
